concurrency: Pure validation functions plus the caller limit value; no shared mutable state.
dependencies: accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API/digest semantics (read-only, unchanged)
accepted C++ X-COM observation contract 1.0.0 (read-only, unchanged)
deployment: Offline, in-process Python library and console entry point inside the admitted ARGUS2 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, provider handle, live tap, registry or oracle is created, started, probed or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/argus-lite/requirements.md ARGUS2-SR-005, realized by ARGUS2-ARCH-05/ARGUS2-ARCH-07 in docs/engineering/argus-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/argus-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Reject malformed or non-finite values, duplicate identities, unsupported versions, unsafe or oversized inputs and every violated caller-configured finite bound.
Emit a stable categorized diagnostic that distinguishes input rejection, I/O failure, unsupported schema, corrupt artifact, missing evidence and known observation loss.
Never silently discard a record, repair a timestamp, guess a producer, substitute an unknown version or accept a partial record.
Treat bounds as implementation limits only; produce no diagnostic without an actual violation.
state_ownership: Owns no durable state; owns the immutable effective-limits value and the diagnostic construction rules.
title: ARGUS2-SR-005-CMP allocation - Fail-closed validation and caller-configured finite bounds
